svg.title: Every idea by difficulty and novelty
svg.desc: Unit chart of 85 agentic iOS app ideas. Horizontal axis: difficulty 1 to 5. Vertical axis: novelty 1 to 5. Each chip is one idea, colored and prefixed by tier. The full table is in ideas/README.md.
svg.text: Where the ideas sit: difficulty × novelty
Each chip is one idea. Look up an ID in the index. Top-right is hard and new; bottom-left is easy and crowded.
